field.label: DoT Listen Address
field.help: Addresses and ports to serve DNS over TLS on, separated by commas. Leave empty to disable. The standard port is 853.

field.label: DoH Listen Address
field.help: Addresses and ports to serve DNS over HTTPS on, separated by commas. Leave empty to disable. The standard port is 443, which usually collides with the web interface.

field.label: DoH Path
field.help: URL path the DNS over HTTPS endpoint is served on.

field.label: Certificate
field.help: The certificate presented to clients. Without one blocky generates a self-signed certificate at startup, which most clients reject.

field.label: Minimum TLS Version
field.help: The oldest TLS version accepted from clients.

field.label: Enable HTTP/3
field.help: Also serve DNS over HTTP/3 on the DoH listener and advertise it to clients.
